description: Screen a truck the way the sell page does. Starts from that class band in the autumn 2026 price book, adjusts for year, hours, grade, and whether the power is known, then returns a low, a point, and a high. A screen, not an appraisal and not a bid. Year on the form runs from 1998 to 2026. Grade is A, B, or C. Power is sound, unknown, or needs-work.

grade.description: A is cleared in writing. B is work ready. C names the defects and is priced as a project.

hours.description: Hours on the meter. The seller screen allows 0 or more.

power.description: sound means the battery or engine is known and sound. unknown means not tested. needs-work means it needs work.

year.description: Model year. The seller screen allows 1998 to 2026.

name: screen_truck
